1170-4124-5334-5954-8345.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4488-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.

Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a 4/4 green Beast creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

955-2023-4770-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

598-5173-6495.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.
598-5173-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

470-2661-5256-7635.notablePrerequisites: The total power of creatures you control is at least 10 plus Ghalta's commander tax.
470-2661-5256-7635.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ghalta from the command zone by paying {G}{G}.
Gwenna and Ascendant Packleader trigger.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ascendant Packleader trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Ghalta. Then, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ghalta.
Choose to return Ghalta to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

141-5147-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5147-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

851-2457-4289-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

654-2034-3875-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Tireless Provisioner and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Ba Sing Se.
Repeat.

Activate the creature by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

586-2146-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5111-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2034-2060-3054-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2034-2060-3054-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2034-2060-3054-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

252-1477-2073--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

4131-5647-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {C}.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2267-2558-4659--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2267-2558-4659--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Tormod triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting any two permanents.
Holding priority, activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Thran Dynamo and Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Thran Dynamo and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

224-225-2157-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Romana II do not have summoning sickness.
224-225-2157-5954.description:
Cast Overlord of the Hauntwoods by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Flesh Duplicate and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Flesh Duplicate from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Flesh Duplicate to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Flesh Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Flesh Duplicate by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1288-3359-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Hofri triggers, exiling Squee from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squee token, adding {R}.
When the Squee token dies, it triggers, returning Squee from exile to your graveyard.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Repeat.

409-2103-4797.notablePrerequisites: Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
409-2103-4797.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

719-1869-3089-3821.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1869-3089-3821.description:

Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Reprieve by paying {1}{W}, returning Approach of the Second Sun to your hand and causing you to draw a card.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

1048-1267-4464-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Slither Blade does not have summoning sickness.
1048-1267-4464-4600-5241.description:
Declare Slither Blade as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Slither Blade from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Slither Blade by paying {U}.
Equilibrium triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

2174-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-3756-4222.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
